Master '''Posavina''' is a [[Kandor]]i merchant with a gray-streaked forked beard and a large pearl in his left ear.
==Activities==
In [[The Golden Wheel]] in [[Far Madding]], he tells another trader, Mistress [[Shimel]], that he intends to go to [[Tear]] instead of [[Illian]], after he has heard that Rand has been crowned King of Illian. Mistress Shimel, however, tells him that the [[Stone of Tear]] is under siege, and thus the nation is not a good place to trade.
